en.title: Dvořák, String Quartet No. 12 "American", III. Molto vivace: Listening Guide
en.overview: This movement is in 3/4 time and has five sections. Its home key is F minor. It opens in a bright F major with a short main theme. Later it turns to a darker F minor. Listen for the main theme returning in different parts and different keys, for sudden jumps between loud and soft, and for a hushed stretch that leads to the loudest moment near the end (a computer estimate). Keys and chords in this guide are estimated by computer, and the "who leads" labels are a rough guess.

listening_points.headline: The main theme, played loudly together
listening_points.text: The movement opens in F major, loud. The parts play the same line, in unison or octaves. That means the same notes at the same or different heights. The second violin has the main theme here [m. 1-4].

listening_points.headline: A sudden drop to soft
listening_points.text: The volume drops at once to soft. One part now has a tune over an accompaniment, meaning the other parts support it. The lead here is probably the second violin, with the viola [m. 5-8].

listening_points.headline: The theme again, now in several parts
listening_points.text: The loud opening returns. This time the theme appears in the first violin, second violin and viola together [m. 9-11]. The first violin probably leads [m. 9-12].

listening_points.headline: Very soft, then a burst of ff
listening_points.text: A very soft passage follows [m. 13-16]. Then the volume jumps to very loud at [m. 17]. The first and second violins answer each other bar by bar [m. 17-20]. Here the analysis is confident about who leads.

listening_points.headline: Soft, then growing louder
listening_points.text: The music is soft again [m. 21-29]. The first violin probably carries the tune. Then the lead passes to the viola [m. 30-31] and the cello [m. 32]. A crescendo, a gradual increase in loudness, is marked at [m. 30].

listening_points.headline: Loud peak, then fading away
listening_points.text: The first violin leads a very loud stretch [m. 33-40]. At [m. 41] the first violin brings back the main theme at its original pitch. The volume drops to medium loud there. A diminuendo, a gradual softening, is marked from there. By [m. 48] the music is very soft.

listening_points.headline: A hushed second section turns to F minor
listening_points.text: Section 2 begins very softly. It is marked a tempo, which means back to the original speed. The first violin leads. The key turns from F major to the darker F minor at [m. 51]. Some bars here are duets, with two parts in the foreground.

listening_points.headline: Accents and tangled lines
listening_points.text: The parts now play independent lines. Each goes its own way. Sharp accents, marked fz, stand out [m. 58]. The first violin probably leads [m. 57-63].

listening_points.headline: A brief brighter key, then quiet passing around
listening_points.text: The key shifts briefly to A-flat major [m. 66-68], then returns to F minor. Later the viola probably takes the tune [m. 73-78]. The cello then probably takes over [m. 79-80]. From [m. 71] on, all of this is very soft.

listening_points.headline: Loud outburst, then quiet again
listening_points.text: At [m. 81] the music jumps to very loud. The first violin probably leads. One part has the tune and the others accompany. At [m. 93] it drops to soft and then very soft by [m. 95].

listening_points.headline: The main theme returns, low and in D minor
listening_points.text: Section 3 begins with the main theme low in the viola and cello, in octaves [m. 97-100]. The key moves to D minor at [m. 99]. The first violin then plays the theme again at [m. 105-107], and the lead is clear there.

listening_points.headline: Louder in steps, and a bright F major
listening_points.text: The volume steps up in sudden jumps: medium loud, loud, then very loud [m. 114-116]. No gradual crescendo is marked. The key brightens to F major at [m. 115]. The parts play independent lines [m. 113-117].

listening_points.headline: Softer, then the theme in full force
listening_points.text: The music steps down to medium loud at [m. 126]. A diminuendo is marked at [m. 127], and it is soft by [m. 128]. Then at [m. 137] it jumps to very loud. The theme comes back in the first and second violins, with the other parts moving along with them. The key slips to D minor at [m. 139], and the volume drops to soft at [m. 141].

listening_points.headline: A short bridge, then a hushed return
listening_points.text: Section 4 is only four bars, very soft, in A minor. The cello probably leads [m. 145-147]. Section 5 then restarts the quiet F minor music from Section 2, led by the first violin.

listening_points.headline: Loud and growing, then softer
listening_points.text: The music jumps to loud at [m. 157]. A crescendo is marked, and sharp accents follow. Lead is shared here. After a brief visit to A-flat major [m. 164-167], a diminuendo is marked [m. 169], and it is soft by [m. 171].

listening_points.headline: Near silence, then the loudest moment
listening_points.text: A very, very soft passage begins at [m. 173]. The parts move together in chords. Then at [m. 181] it jumps to very loud. The analysis marks [m. 182] as the loudest, busiest point. This is a computer estimate.

listening_points.headline: Winding down to a whisper
listening_points.text: The very loud music continues until [m. 191]. It drops to soft at [m. 192] and then very soft at [m. 194]. The movement ends quietly in F minor.

glossary.explanation: Parts play the same notes, at the same or different heights.
One part has the tune while the others support it.
The parts move together in chords.
Each part plays its own line.
A sharp accent on a note.
The home note and scale of the music. Major sounds brighter and minor darker.
Two parts are in the foreground.

zh.title: 德沃夏克：弦乐四重奏第12号 “美国” 第三乐章 Molto vivace 听赏指南
zh.overview: 这是一个3/4拍的快速乐章，共196小节，分为五个部分，主调是F小调。开头的主旋律会在不同声部和不同高度反复出现。请留意力度的突然变化，以及调性在明亮的大调和较暗的小调之间转换。说明：调性与和弦均为软件估算，可能有误。“谁在带领旋律”也只是估算，把握低的地方只能说“可能”。

listening_points.headline: 主旋律在强奏中亮相
listening_points.text: 乐章以强（f）开始。第二小提琴先奏出主旋律，大提琴在低八度上也奏同一旋律 [m. 1-3]。这几小节是齐奏或八度重合，也就是各声部唱同一条线，只差高低八度。估算调性为F大调。第二小提琴可能是带领者，但把握不高。

listening_points.headline: 突然转弱，带有渐强渐弱
listening_points.text: 力度从强一下子变为弱（p）。织体变成旋律加伴奏，也就是一个声部唱旋律，其他声部伴奏。这里有渐强和渐弱的标记 [m. 5-7]。

listening_points.headline: 主旋律由三个声部同时奏出
listening_points.text: 第一小提琴、第二小提琴和中提琴在 [m. 9-11] 同时奏出主旋律，以齐奏或八度的方式一起演奏。力度又回到强（f）。第10小节和第12小节有 fz 记号，意思是突然加重。

listening_points.headline: 从很弱猛然跳到很强，再减弱
listening_points.text: [m. 13-15] 很弱（pp），随后 [m. 17] 突然变成很强（ff）。第16小节没有渐强标记，所以这是突然的变化。第一、第二小提琴逐小节轮流领奏 [m. 17-20]。第19小节起降为中强（mf）并逐渐减弱。

listening_points.headline: 轻柔的流动，旋律在声部间传递
listening_points.text: 力度回到弱（p）。第一小提琴大概带着旋律，但把握不高。接着旋律依次传给第二小提琴 [m. 29]、中提琴 [m. 30-31] 和大提琴 [m. 32]。中提琴处有渐强，然后进入中强（mf）。

listening_points.headline: 很强的段落后，主旋律回到第一小提琴
listening_points.text: 第33小节起很强（ff），第一小提琴可能在带领。第41小节主旋律回到第一小提琴，与开头同高 [m. 41-43]。此时力度突然降为中强（mf），并带有重音与渐弱标记。

listening_points.headline: 渐弱到很弱，新部分转入小调
listening_points.text: [m. 45-48] 渐弱，从弱（p）到很弱（pp）。第49小节进入第二部分（a tempo，回到原速），第一小提琴带着旋律。从第51小节起，估算调性变为F小调，色彩变暗。第50小节起有二重奏织体。

listening_points.headline: 线条交错、重音突出，短暂转入降A大调
listening_points.text: [m. 57-63] 是独立线条，各声部各走各的路，第一小提琴可能领头。这里有 fz 和 fp 等重音记号。第62小节起为强（f）。第66至68小节短暂转到降A大调，第67小节是三个声部的三重奏织体。

listening_points.headline: 中提琴与大提琴接过旋律，很弱
listening_points.text: 力度为很弱（pp）。中提琴可能在带领 [m. 73-78]，随后大提琴可能接手 [m. 79-80]。这两处把握都不高，可以当作低声部之间的传递。第74、79、80小节是二重奏织体。

listening_points.headline: 突然爆发的很强，再退回很弱
listening_points.text: 第81小节突然进入很强（ff），旋律加伴奏。带领者不明确，第一小提琴可能占优。第89至92小节转到降A大调，并有渐弱标记。第93小节回到弱（p），第95小节为很弱（pp）。

listening_points.headline: 第三部分：主旋律沉到低音区
listening_points.text: 第97小节新部分开始，力度为弱（p）。中提琴和大提琴在低音区奏出主旋律，中提琴比开头低八度，大提琴低两个八度 [m. 97-99]。估算调性在第99小节转为D小调。第105小节起，第一小提琴在D小调中以原来的高度奏出主旋律 [m. 105-107]。

listening_points.headline: 力度一级级上升，转入F大调
listening_points.text: 第112小节很弱（pp），随后一路抬高：p、mf、f，到第116小节为很强（ff）。各声部以独立线条推动这一上升，没有明确的领奏声部。第115小节估算调性转为F大调，色彩变亮。

listening_points.headline: 很强的主旋律回归，再转弱
listening_points.text: 第137小节很强（ff），第一、第二小提琴奏出主旋律 [m. 137-139]。织体为主调织体：旋律在上，其他声部以和弦相伴。第139小节估算转入D小调。第141小节突然变弱（p）。

listening_points.headline: 很弱的过渡，进入最后部分
listening_points.text: 第四部分只有4小节（a tempo），估算调性为A小调，力度很弱（pp），大提琴可能带领。第149小节最后一部分开始，第一小提琴带旋律。第150小节起估算回到F小调，保持很弱。

listening_points.headline: 强奏推进，经降A大调后渐弱
listening_points.text: 第157小节突然变强（f），并有渐强和重音标记。带领者不明确。第164至167小节估算转到降A大调，第168小节回到F小调。接着渐弱，第171小节为弱（p）。

listening_points.headline: 极弱之后的最强点，最后轻声收尾
listening_points.text: [m. 173-180] 是极弱（ppp）的主调织体。第181小节突然跳到很强（ff），并带渐强标记。分析软件估算最响最忙处在第182小节。第189至192小节转降A大调并有渐弱标记，第193小节回到F小调。乐章在很弱（pp）中结束 [m. 194-196]。

glossary.explanation: 乐章开头出现的那条易记的曲调，之后会在不同声部和不同高度回来。
各声部唱同一条线，只是有的高八度、有的低八度。
一个声部唱旋律，其他声部在下面伴奏。
旋律在上，其他声部以和弦相伴，各声部节奏大体一致。
各声部各唱各的旋律线，互不相同。
声音逐渐变响或逐渐变轻。乐谱上有标记才算渐变，否则是突然变化。
重音记号。fz是突然加重一下，fp是先强后立刻转弱。
大调听起来较明亮，小调听起来较暗淡。本指南中的调性是软件估算的。
